page.content:
Mercer's world of Tal'Dorei, Wildemount, Marquet, and the gods.

How Exandria connects

  • Character: Matthew Mercer — Matthew Mercer created the world of Exandria.
  • Location: Tal'Dorei — Tal'Dorei is a continent of Exandria.
  • Location: Wildemount — Wildemount is a continent of Exandria.

What is Exandria?

Exandria is the campaign world Matthew Mercer built: Tal'Dorei for Vox Machina, Wildemount for the Mighty Nein, Marquet for Bells Hells, and a shared pantheon and Calamity history.

Key threads lead to Matthew Mercer, Tal'Dorei and Wildemount.
